prompt: My coworker Dana always congratulates me in team meetings, but I just heard she's been telling our manager my project is 'risky' and that I'm 'in over my head.' She was super friendly when I started 3 months ago, took me to lunch, offered to show me the ropes. What's going on with her and how should I handle it?
assertions: Identifies envy as the likely driver (Law of Envy / fragile ego)
Notes the overly eager early friendliness as a warning sign of envy
